verdict.rationale: Sentry instruments applications through language SDKs and explicitly says there are "No agents to install." Nothing in the pack shows vendor-maintained agents or integrations for hosts, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure. OTLP ingestion through the third-party OpenTelemetry Collector is a developer building block, not a vendor-maintained infrastructure agent. The Cloudflare Workers integration captures application errors only, not infrastructure telemetry.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services through vendor-maintained agents and integrations
